terms.gloss: careful you don’t fall; stand still
terms.comment: In Libellus VII the boy sings it to himself as he climbs.

phrases.latin: Pater «Cavē nē cadās,» inquit; quod puer, dum scandit, ipse sibi cantat.
phrases.english: Dad said “Careful you don’t fall”; and the boy sings it to himself as he climbs.
Careful you don’t fall; stand still (Plaut. Most. 324, in the Libellus II gloss).
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

phrases.english: Stay by the wall, not by the edge.

sources: Lewis & Short: caveo · Lewis & Short: asto
